chunks: Ibn al-Mughīrah narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, who said:

I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who was in Ṭawāf al-Nisāʾ when the prayer was established. He said: “He should perform the obligatory prayer with them, and when he finishes, he should continue from where he had reached.”

key_terms.بَنَى: he resumes and continues from where he left off
key_terms.طَوَافِ ٱلنِّسَاءِ: the circumambulation of women, a specific hajj rite
key_terms.ٱلصَّلَاةُ: the prayer that has been commenced or established

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if the obligatory prayer begins while performing ṭawāf al-nisāʾ?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one whose ṭawāf al-nisāʾ is interrupted by the commencement of the obligatory prayer. He should join the congregational obligatory prayer, then resume his circumambulation from the point at which he stopped.
